purpose: Close the exact-primary-condition scope gap between the Step 79 V2 legacy-wrapper audit and the paper's Step 54 matrix-free public-reference headline condition.

already_observed: Step 54 old-backend matrix-free public-reference effects were +3.2657, +3.7851, and +0.9552 cumulative deployed regret on MedQA, GSM8K, and OpenBookQA.
Step 54 fixed-query query matrices were identical and its reported primary effects were exactly null under the historical backend.
Step 79 V2 clean-active value and legacy-wrapper refinement gates passed on seed block 50000--50499.
Step 79 closed all candidate-permutation failures on its audited legacy scenarios and passed its complete 3-by-3 tie grid.
The current abstract and primary results table use Step 54 matrix-free numbers, not Step 79 legacy-wrapper numbers.
not_yet_observed: The Step 54 primary matrix-free scenario under V2 canonical acquisition on seeds 91000--91499.
Clean-active versus clean-random value on the exact Step 54 main seed block.
Exact candidate-permutation invariance of the main matrix-free refined registry.
The main matrix-free effect under all nine V2 query/root tie-policy cells.
The sequential excess over any fixed-query root-selection effect under V2.

v2_semantics.canonical_entry_order: full response-vector SHA256, root ID, label SHA256, label fallback
v2_semantics.response_groups: exact string groups with content-addressed identities
v2_semantics.group_reduction: numeric sort followed by fixed float64 squared-sum reduction
v2_semantics.tie_equality: exact float64 only; no tolerance, rounding, epsilon, or jitter

random_and_fixed_controls.clean_random: For paired pool seed s, sample without replacement using Python random.Random(s + 99173).
random_and_fixed_controls.fixed_query: Reuse Step 54 fixed_random_queries with seed 191000 + task_index*1000 + run_index for clean and refined registries.

permutation_audit.scope: clean and matrix-free refined registries, all three tasks, all 500 pools
permutation_audit.required: zero query, selected-root, root-regret, selected-acquisition-value, and canonical-digest mismatches

statistics.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across the three tasks within each contrast family

adjudication.STRONG_TRANSFER: Construction integrity, active-value, all-task main harm, all-task sequential-excess harm, exact permutation invariance, all-cell cumulative tie robustness, and MedQA/GSM8K terminal support all pass.
adjudication.CUMULATIVE_TRANSFER: Every STRONG_TRANSFER item except terminal support passes; narrow terminal wording while retaining trajectory/cumulative claims.
adjudication.AUDIT_ONLY_TRANSFER: Integrity/permutation pass and every task has positive mean cumulative harm, but active-value, sequential-excess, or all-cell confidence requirements fail; switch to audit framing.
adjudication.BLOCKED: Any frozen binding fails, any task loses cumulative direction, or candidate permutation remains non-invariant; prohibit manuscript promotion.

forbidden_changes: No task, target, seed block, pool, budget, temperature, alias count, distance, support salt, answer generator, or constructor change.
No use of the legacy matrix-aware wrapper as evidence for main matrix-free transfer.
No tolerance, jitter, rounding, approximate tie, or candidate insertion-order rule.
No outcome-selected permutation or hash seed.
No replacement of a failed task or policy cell.
No manuscript number replacement before independent validation.
